caseName: National Mutual Building & Loan Ass'n v. Farnham
caseNameFull: National Mutual Building and Loan Association of New York, in Error v. G. R. Farnham, etc.

opinions.text: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Mississippi. Submitted April 18, 1904. Decided April 25, 1904. Per Curiam. Judgmept affirmed' with costs and interest, on the authority of The National Mutual Building and Loan Association of New York v. Brahan, 193 U. S. 635. Mr. J. S. Sexton and Mr. A. S. Bozeman for plaintiff in error. Mr. J. C. Bryson for defendant in error.
